title: Interactive Coding: Dictionary Management
subtitle: Key-Value Store Lookups & Updates
description: Work with key-value mappings across 3 interactive stages!

challenges.title: Stage 1: Direct Key Lookup
challenges.description: Access and print the name value: <hlt>print(user["name"])</hlt>.

challenges.title: Stage 2: Safe Lookup with .get()
challenges.description: Use <hlt>user.get("email", "Not Provided")</hlt> to safely handle missing keys without error. Print result.

challenges.title: Stage 3: Insert & Update Key
challenges.starter_code:
user = {"name": "Alice", "age": 25, "role": "Engineer"}
# Stage 3: Insert new key
user["active"] = True
print(user["active"])
